rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided Gardner 3AA label, but the image alone does not clearly support a fully confident claim of a prominent centrally located ICM, continuous TE ring, or visible zona thinning; some features appear inferred rather than directly visible.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF outcome, sperm parameters, BMI, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis in a clinically meaningful way, though some links are overstated.

The structure is logical, but the probability estimate seems overly penalized relative to a 29-year-old with a 3AA day-5 blastocyst, and some deductions (stress, alcohol, prior single failed cycle) are presented with more certainty than the evidence supports.

Core points on embryo quality and general prognosis are reasonable, but several recommendations are not guideline-based or are overused (routine ERA, immunologic testing/NK cells, G-CSF, PRP, aspirin, broad PGT-A recommendation in a 29-year-old), reducing alignment with ASRM/ESHRE standards.

Provides clear next-step options and practical suggestions for transfer versus freeze-all planning, endometrial optimization, and lifestyle modification, though some proposed interventions are not strongly evidence-based.
